name: health-insight

scripts.dev: npm run dev --workspace=@health/api & npm run dev --workspace=@health/web
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=@health/shared && npm run build --workspace=@health/web
scripts.db:migrate:deploy: if [ "$VERCEL_ENV" = production ]; then npm run db:migrate; else echo "skipping migrations: VERCEL_ENV=${VERCEL_ENV:-unset}"; fi

//dependencies: The Vercel function entry in api/ sits outside the workspaces, so its imports resolve from here rather than from @health/api. Keep these in step with apps/api/package.json.
